resolution_standard: resolve only when public repository evidence proves exactly one deterministic existing outcome; low confidence remains unresolved

confidence_policy.high: all identities exact, one outcome uniquely supported, no competing interpretation, multiple consistent artifacts
confidence_policy.medium: one outcome clearly strongest, minor non-material evidence absent, no reasonable competing outcome, and rule permits resolution
confidence_policy.low: ambiguous, incomplete, conflicting, or source-dependent evidence; final unresolved records must use low adjudication confidence
